title: Princess Maker: Yumemiru Yousei
native_title: プリンセス・メーカー ～ゆめみる妖精～
overview:
A fairy's daughter has come to your home!

- An adorable daughter entrusted to you by the fairies. Will she strive to become a princess? Or...

A tiny fairy dreams of becoming a human princess, and the fairy queen grants her a human form so she can try. In this raising simulation from the Princess Maker series, you take her in and have eight years to bring her up into a grown woman. First choose your own profession, which shapes the events that unfold. Then plan her schedule, go shopping, change her clothes, talk with her and check her status as the calendar turns. The choices you make lead to one of many different endings.

- Raising simulation for one player
- Festivals and other events
- Multiple endings
- Memory backup

あなたの家に、妖精の娘がやってきた!

◆妖精から授かった可愛い娘。プリンセス目指してがんばる?それとも…
